subject: Trading
title: Stocks, Bonds, and Beyond
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Stocks, Bonds, and Beyond.

hook.text: Stocks, bonds, currencies, commodities, crypto—each trades in its own market with its own rules.

buildup.text: A stock is a slice of company ownership. A bond is a loan you make to a government or corporation.

discovery.text: Commodities are physical goods like oil and wheat. Currencies trade in pairs on the forex market.

twist.text: Derivatives—options, futures—don't trade the asset itself. They trade contracts about its future price.

climax.text: Every market instrument is a different way to bet on, hedge, or profit from economic activity.

quiz.question: What is a derivative?
options: A contract based on an asset's future price
